title: spec-schema-validation.json lifecycle is undocumented and the file is not created by moeb init
description: `src/moeb/src/domain/spec_schema.rs` reads `spec-schema-validation.json` from the working directory at runtime but falls back to built-in rules when the file is absent. The module is not declared in `domain/mod.rs`, suggesting it may only be referenced from test modules and may be dead code in the production binary. `moeb init` does not copy a starter schema file to new projects, so new projects silently use only the built-in fallback without being informed. The relationship between the filesystem override, the built-in rules, and the module's compilation status is undocumented.
proposed_resolution: 1. Determine whether `spec_schema.rs` is reachable in the production binary by checking if it is declared via `mod` in any non-test context. If it is dead code, remove the file and the `.moeb/spec-schema-validation.json` artifact from the moeb repository. 2. If it is live code, bundle `spec-schema-validation.json` as an embedded asset and have `moeb init` copy it to `.moeb/`, ensuring new projects receive the correct schema automatically. 3. Document the override mechanism and fallback behaviour in `.moeb/README.md`.
